tradition.name: Alternative roots rock
tradition.lineage: Alternative roots rock is represented here by Black Pistol Fire. This is one documented branch, with an authored present-day studio realization.

extras.description: Alternative roots rock is represented by Black Pistol Fire’s guitar-and-drums duo branch. Its releasing label identifies a Toronto/Austin practice and a blend of southern-rock and garage-punk references; Kevin McKeown performs guitar and lead voice and Eric Owen drums. The authored model keeps this bass-less duo core. Exact room, equipment, tuning and part choices are authored present-day production defaults.
